heading: The Silent Epidemic of Insulin Resistance
alt: Yale reports insulin resistance in about 40 percent of US adults, and more than 1 in 3 has prediabetes

heading: How Do You Reverse Insulin Resistance?
alt: Three evidence-based levers: about 10 percent weight loss, 150 minutes of exercise weekly, and a whole-food plate

heading: Nutrition as Medicine
alt: Three dietary levers: fiber to slow sugar absorption, protein and fats to steady blood sugar, less added sugar
